extractedText: Leh & Ladakh Pre-Event News for Entrepreneur Awareness & Special Vendor Development Program on 5th June 2026 (Friday) Last updated: 2 June 2026 10:08 PM By blackandwhitedigitalnews.com Share 2 Min Read Pre-Event News for Entrepreneur Awareness & Special Vendor Development Program on 5th June 2026 (Friday) SHARE Pre-Event News for Entrepreneur Awareness & Special Vendor Development Program on 5th June 2026 (Friday) National SC-ST Hub, Ludhiana under the Ministry of MSME (Government of India) is organising an “Entrepreneur Awareness & Special Vendor Development Programme” for Existing and Aspiring SC-ST Entrepreneurs in association with the Dalit Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DICCI) – North India at Central Institute of Buddhist Studies, Choglamsar, Leh, Ladakh-194104 on 5th June, 2026 at 9 AM Onwards. Leh is all set to witness an important Entrepreneur Awareness & Special Vendor Development Programme aimed at promoting business opportunities and skill development among existing and aspiring SC-ST entrepreneurs. The event is scheduled to be held at Central Institute of Buddhist Studies, Choglamsar, Leh, Ladakh-194104 The programme is being organized to educate participants about various government schemes, financial support systems and business development strategies. Experts and representatives from different organizations will be present to guide attendees and share valuable insights. Participants will also get an opportunity to interact with industry and banking professionals from GeM, HPCL, POWERGRID, FCI, NTPC, SBI and other Government Organizations like MSME DFO Jammu, Social & Tribal Welfare Department, training institute like ITI and gain practical knowledge about starting and managing their own ventures. The event is expected to attract a large number of existing and budding entrepreneurs from SC-ST Community from Leh, Ladakh. Organizers have expressed their confidence that the programme will play a significant role in encouraging self-employment and boosting local people.
